title: Check Your Answers Flow
description: Pre-submission review page: summary list of answers with Change links, key information inset, and submit button.

components.reason: Each answer with a visually-labelled Change link pointing at its question page
Warning that submitting is final, or key deadline information
'Accept and send' — the transaction's final action

nesting: Component 1 is the page body; component 2 sits above it; component 3 sits below the list
validationOrder: Every row has a Change link stating what it changes (visually-hidden suffix)
The submit button wording reflects finality ('Accept and send')
a11yNotes: Change links must include visually-hidden context ('Change name')
Do not remove the summary-list dl semantics
agentPromptSequence: 1. Build one summary-list row per answered question
2. Add the finality inset above the list
